newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks slip as cross deals dominate.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks slip as cross deals dominate.

text.p: Colombian stocks drifted down Tuesday in markets dominated by cross trades and by low volume sales of blue chips, brokers said.

Bogota's IBB index fell 0.4 percent to 836.9 in volume of 3.01 billion pesos -- 2.67 billion of which was one cross trade in savings bank and building society Granahorrar, whose price remained unchanged at 10.2 pesos.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index dropped 0.26 percent to 13,228.51 in trade of 1.13 billion pesos. Over 429 million pesos of that was a cross deal in Banco Industrial Colombiano (BIC), part of the Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate.
